posts.name: Samwise137
posts.cooked:
Jeysie:

I really like the idea of Tales From the Archive, but I think the poor fellow forgets he's storytelling and not strategizing sometimes. The strategerist spirit is strong in the Sentinels fandom. Not that it's easy to think on the fly with an audience. Also when the cards throw you a curveball.

It's not that I forget that I'm storytelling, it's that I play WAY too fast if I try to storyboard every play. I was watching back my early replays and I was moving altogether way too fast. I don't have enough time in the week to write a five or six or seven part story. That's why I started sourcing dialogue bits from the chat.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked: I don't mind the sourcing/collaborating, makes it feel like a Sentinels roleplaying campaign but with cards instead of stats. :) I enjoy your Saturday stream a lot; it covers very different ground from the Sentinels Live and Lewd's shows. (I didn't mean to sound harsh, basically, and I'm sorry if I came off that way.)
